# Extended Technical Profile — Marcin Świderski

## Personal Summary
Marcin Świderski is a .NET Backend Engineer and Infrastructure Builder based in Cracow, Poland. He specializes in designing robust REST APIs, microservice architectures with C# and .NET 10, automated job scheduling with Hangfire, containerized deployments with Docker, and self-hosted infrastructure built on TrueNAS SCALE.

## Technical Skills Matrix
- **Core Languages**: C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL, C++, PHP, HTML5, CSS3
- **Frameworks & Ecosystem**: .NET 10 / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core REST API, Hangfire, Entity Framework Core, Vue 3, Flutter, Semantic Kernel
- **Databases & Storage**: PostgreSQL, ZFS Storage, SQL Server
- **DevOps & Infrastructure**: Docker, TrueNAS SCALE, Cloudflare Tunnels, Tailscale VPN, Linux (Ubuntu/Debian), Datadog APM, Git, Bitbucket Pipelines, CI/CD
- **Practices**: Clean Architecture, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), SOLID Principles, Prompt Engineering, LLM Integration, Agile/Scrum

## Projects Showcase
### DropFlow (SaaS Dropshipping Platform)
An automated SaaS solution linking e-commerce marketplaces to streamline product listing, order routing, and inventory tracking. Features AI-powered title and description generation optimized for search engines via Semantic Kernel and custom LLM prompts.

### HomeLab Infrastructure
A self-hosted private server stack running TrueNAS SCALE on custom hardware (Ryzen 9 5900X, 64GB RAM). Features ZFS pool redundancy, 14+ active Docker containers, secure remote access via Tailscale and Cloudflare Tunnels, automated backup retention, and high-availability web hosting (hosting this portfolio site).

### Tinder Copilot
A Proof-of-Concept Chrome extension that embeds an AI assistant into dating app chat interfaces. Uses DOM observers and LLM context extraction to provide real-time autocomplete suggestions, conversational icebreakers, and chess-style move evaluations.
